photo.caption: The 1898 Ireland team before playing England
photo.description: The Ireland national rugby team that played England. February 1898: The Irish team, winners of the Home Nations rugby international match against England at Richmond Athletic Ground on 5th February 1898. Amongst them are Pierce O'Brien-Butler, Francis Purser, Sam Lee, Lucius Gwynn, Lawrence Bulger, Glynn Allen, Louis Magee, John Ryan, Michael Ryan, Harry Lindsay, James Franks, James Lytle, John McIlwaine, William Byron and J. L. Davis. The Graphic - published 12th February 1898
